body_lead: Global technology firm HCLTech has inaugurated its first delivery center in Kerala, located at Infopark in Kochi. This center is positioned to serve the growing engineering and research and development (R&D) needs of clients across industries including automotive, semiconductors, medical devices, and industrial technology. At this center, HCLTech will focus on providing customised Artificial Intelligence (AI) silicon solutions aimed at helping clients accelerate their product development cycles.
